subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention amend for renewal / seat increase
messages:
From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@nomadtech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@nomadtech.com; procurement@nomadtech.com
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / retention question for upcoming renewal (RDW-4921)

Hi Jordan,

NomadTech is approaching renewal and we're planning to expand from 40 to 75 seats and increase log retention for our audit team. Before we sign, two items are blocking procurement:

1) SOC 2 recertification timing — can you confirm whether Redwood's next attestation will be complete before our contract renewal date (2028-04-01)?

2) Retention window — our compliance team needs a 540-day audit log retention SLA. Current contract shows 365 days. Is an amendment available (and any associated cost)?

We also need a short list of evidence artifacts your team can provide for the re-attestation (system configs, log export samples, access audit records). If you can share an inventory and an estimate of how long the bulk evidence handoff will take, that will help our security and procurement cadence.

Can we get an internal Redwood contact for evidence staging and a tentative timeline?

Thanks,
Alex Wong
Head of IT Security
NomadTech

Attachment: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wong <alex.wong@nomadtech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; kimberly_park@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai; procurement@nomadtech.com
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / retention question for upcoming renewal (RDW-4921)

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Marissa (Compliance), Kimberly (Security Solutions), and Ben (Customer Success) to scope. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2: our current recertification is in progress and the letter is expected by 2028-03-22; we can provide interim evidence now and the official attestation as soon as it's finalized.
- Retention: 540 days is outside our standard hosted retention tiers, but we can prepare an addendum for 540d retention with a pricing delta and an SLA.
- Evidence: we'll put together an inventory and a staged handoff plan (bulk export + sample logs). Estimated prep + transfer time: 6-8 business days depending on volume.

Marissa / Kimberly / Ben — can you confirm the evidence inventory items we can share by next Tue (2028-03-13) and whether our infra team can support a bulk export to the NomadTech S3 bucket? Also include any notes about redaction/PII filter steps.

Alex — if useful, I can schedule a 30-minute sync to align procurement and security on 2028-03-08 or 2028-03-10. Which works?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Alex Wong <alex.wong@nomadtech.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai; procurement@nomadtech.com
Date: Wed, 7 Mar 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / retention question for upcoming renewal (RDW-4921)

Hi Alex / team — thanks for the heads up. Quick inventory we can provide (we'll attach a CSV manifest during handoff):

- System configuration snapshots (control plane, KMS policies) — redacted for customer keys
- Auth & access logs (admin console events) — redact user email addresses on request
- API request logs (tokenized) for the last 365d — can be extended to requested window if agreed in addendum
- Incident response timeline and root-cause artifacts for the last 12 months
- SOC 2 bridge letter (if needed) and final attestation when issued (ETA 2028-03-22)

For the 540d retention: operationally we will instruct our export engine to include older logs, but two things to note:
1) Storage cost bump + incremental egress if delivering to NomadTech bucket
2) Some logs (debug-level agent traces) are pruned at 400d by default; we can include preserved indexes and reconstructed sequences but it increases handoff time.

I recommend the following plan:
- Confirm seat increase and retention request by 2028-03-08 (Jordan to update billing contact).
- We prepare a manifest and share sample exports (3-day window) by 2028-03-13.
- Bulk export to your S3 (prefered) or secure transfer window scheduled for week of 2028-03-20.

Can someone from NomadTech confirm S3 bucket name and whether they require KMS-wrapped objects?

Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_inventory_20280306.csv (stub)
From: Alex Wong <alex.wong@nomadtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nomadtech.com; security@nomadtech.com
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / retention question for upcoming renewal (RDW-4921)

Thanks Marissa — that sounds reasonable. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can provide an S3 bucket (nomadtech-audit-uploads), prefer server-side encryption with AES256. No external KMS wrap required.
- Procurement confirms they need the retention amendment and seat uplift agreed in writing by 2028-03-15 to process renewal paperwork.
- For pruned debug traces: if those are not recoverable, we can accept reconstructed indexes + an attestation of what was pruned.

Jordan — let's take the 30-minute sync on 2028-03-10 at 09:00 PT. Please include Marissa and Kimberly to walk the evidence flow and the billing amendment.

Alex

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
